content: Revolutionizing Manufacturing with Scrap: A Vision for Point-of-Need Production in Austere Environments Global supply chains are facing increasing challenges, highlighting the need for new approaches to material production. One promising avenue involves developing methods to create high-performance materials from low-quality, variable scrap feedstocks. In ML and SL for materials discovery, one size does not fit all, traditional error metrics may not be a good predictor of success, and the specifics of the design challenge have important implications for the optimal configuration of materials discovery strategies.
